newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq down slightly in continued holiday lull.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq down slightly in continued holiday lull.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index took a slight dip Friday as the holiday lull continued for another day.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 3.19 or 0.25 percent to unofficially close at 1291.38. The Dow gained 14.23 points to unofficially close at 6560.91. The benchmark, 30-year bond gained 20/32 to yield 6.54 percent.
Trading was "extremely quiet," said Patrick Davis, the head of OTC trading at Salomon Brothers. "A little bit of year-end stuff, but nothing fancy."

Some technology stocks came under pressure after news from Computer Associates International Inc that its third quarter revenues may fall below estimates because of a softness in the European market, Davis said.
Intel Corp was down 1-1/4 to 135-3/8, Oracle Corp was down 1-3/16 to 42-7/8, while Novell Inc was down 1/16 to 9-1/2.
